rules.level_zero: absent skill, represented only in tables; not an equip choice
rules.four_byte_values: value is readable decimal; float32_hex/exact_float32 preserve original storage
rules.throwing_example_1_2: Not assumed. Confirmed skill8 level1 is motion rate1.1 and local launch-vector multiplier1.15; level2 motion rate is1.2.

conditions: Weapon class 2/3/4/5/6 selects skill ID 1/2/3/4/5 through 0x8C9DD8.
Reload 0x385B88 uses literal 1.0 when attack+0x128 bit6 is set; otherwise virtual+0x134 supplies this rate.
This is a motion rate, not direct damage or a duration multiplier; each weapon motion and refill event remain separate.

surveyor_range_multiplier.target: online weapon range parameter field +0x34; used by crosshair and lock-on paths
conditions: Successful online weapon parameter load in 0x8CC0E0.
D34C90 applies the weapon-info actor-flag range bonus first; 8CC0E0 then applies Surveyor; the lock-acquire environment expression occurs later.
0x8CC20C queries skill ID7, then 0x8CC24C/0x8CC250 multiplies the range.
Absent level0 is 0.9 times the weapon table base, not 1.0. Values are not relative to the absent-skill result.
With original actor flags0, AK102 weapon ID25 base range8000 gives [7200,8000,9600,11200] before the later environment expression. Width and angle are separate parameters.

Crosshair candidate 0x83EAA8 uses weapon range directly. Lock acquire 0x35EAF8 applies an additional 0xC05C38 expression and minimum3000; retention allows acquire range+1000. These are not extra Surveyor multipliers.
Online attack vtable0x1196970 +0x140 resolves to0x837078, which reads skill ID8.
The throwing branch in0x39F028 calls the getter at0x39F30C and writes motion-request rate+8.
A second getter at0x39F35C supplies0x3337D8 (r4=1,r5=2), then0xD4DF48 writes active motion+0x38.
This speeds up the throwing motion; it is not a launch-vector or distance multiplier. Branch, posture and release timing remain separate.

throw_launch_vector_multiplier.target: skill-dependent local throwing launch-vector components, before rotation and owner-motion addition
conditions: Online attack vtable0x1196970 +0x13C resolves to0x8370C8, which reads skill ID8.
0x39CDA8 throwing branches multiply local launch-vector values based on18000/12000/6000, rotate the vector and store attack+0x180.
After the motion-release check,0x39EA88 calls0x39CDA8 at0x39EC48, reads+0x180 at0x39ECB8 and adds owner+0x2D0 at0x39ECC8.

After owner-motion addition,0x39ECF4 scales xyz by the original float32 0.001 constant (0x11ABB54).0x39EDFC passes this vector to0x7B98B8; that producer scales xyz by1000.0 (0x11C4F8C) and stores projectile+0x240/+0x244/+0x248. SI units remain unresolved; neither scale is a skill multiplier.

The multiplier applies before owner-motion addition. It is not a blanket multiplier on the final world velocity, projectile damage, fuse duration or achieved distance. Ballistics and collision also affect distance.
